theorem round_eq_iff {x : α} {n : ℤ} : round x = n ↔ x ∈ Ico (n - (2:α)⁻¹ : α) (n + (2:α)⁻¹) := by
  norm_num [round_eq, floor_eq_iff, ← lt_sub_iff_add_lt, add_sub_assoc]
